note: SRG+ Drive in Finder editing kill switch (SRGDEV-801). level 0 = read-only for every Mac. Higher levels only take effect in builds that implement them and on Macs whose 'Allow editing in Finder' toggle is on (optInOnly). A build listed in disabledBuilds stays read-only. The extension re-reads this file every 10 minutes and treats it as missing after 24 hours without a successful fetch. Changing it needs the owner's OK. Design: srgplus/srgplus docs/architecture/finder-drive-editing-design.md 13.4 item 7. agentFiles (SRGDEV-821) switches the generated agent files (hidden AGENTS.md per folder), independent of the editing level; off when missing. fileEdits (SRGDEV-802/843) lets saving over a file in a content folder replace it in SRG+ (same asset, new bytes; the old object is removed after 24 hours); off when missing, remove it to roll back.
